name: Labouchere (Cancellation)

claim_quotes: you only need to win 1/3 of your bets to return a profit
if you can complete a full Labouchere betting sequence, then it will provide profits

notes: NEEDS A REGISTERED MACHINE to backtest: the stake equals the sum of the first+last entries of a running list that is edited each round (cross off two entries on a win, append the lost stake on a loss). This list-editing state is not expressible by the current schema progressions.

The extracted win_rate 0.333 is the promoter's BREAK-EVEN threshold ('win 1/3 of bets to profit'), not a predicted win frequency; recorded as claimed because the source states it as the system's selling point.
